title: Within-foot stance-force shape dispersion does not establish added cross-collection Parkinson discrimination
abstract: Within-foot normalized stance-force shape dispersion did not establish added cross-collection Parkinson discrimination beyond timing, coordination, scalar force variability and bilateral mean-shape asymmetry. In exploratory NDD-to-PDB transfer (163 target people), baseline/augmented log loss was 0.629772/0.630048; paired gain -0.000276 (conditional 95% interval [-0.000627, 0.000081]); AUC 0.747397/0.745713. Joint source/target refit intervals include zero in both directions. This detector/model-specific negative result does not establish equivalence or absence of physiological information.
